# Security Policy

If you discover a security related issue, please email musettitommaso@gmail.com
instead of opening a public issue, or use GitHub's private
["Report a vulnerability"](https://github.com/TommasoMusetti/filament-doc-studio/security/advisories/new)
form.

Please include what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead.

Templates are user written content, so reports are especially welcome about
merge fields reaching data a data source never declared, about template content
escaping into the rendered HTML, or about the PDF engine fetching remote
resources.
